problem: Named checkpoints saved RAM only, while the external OS/game overlay paths were saved at the end of a later continued run. Pairing those points can restore a later pagefile beneath earlier RAM. Timed checkpoints also had their overlays overwritten at run end.
behavior: With CPU stopped, save RAM plus OS/game overlays; write a complete manifest with file sizes and SHA-256 last. Named checkpoint companions are STATE.hda-overlay.bin and STATE.game-overlay.bin. Timed/draw-count saves honor explicit overlay output paths and retain those sectors through the later run end. Normal final saves also produce a matching bundle.
tests: Real Win98 control checkpoint wrote all three matching components and a complete manifest; all component sizes and streamed SHA-256 verified.
limitation: Earlier standalone checkpoint/overlay combinations are not retroactively validated. Existing native failures are not attributed to this mismatch without reproduction.
